title: A review's done names a loaded host for tests.py -n 2, -x or --durations as for a bare whole-suite run
goal: bl_land.is_whole_suite counts a tests.py run as whole wherever tests.run_scope gives it mode full (no -k, no named file, no --changed, no -m), reusing one helper (bl_intake.heavy_check or run_scope) instead of a second copy, so a review check such as tests.py -n 2 or --durations=5 is refused at a loaded host before it starts, as the plain run is

gates.question: How does is_whole_suite reuse the one helper for what narrows a tests.py run?
gates.reason: it is the function that gives the test.run mode, so a named file, -k and --changed agree with it, and heavy_check does not see named files or -m
